name: pitchmark-rules-tests
description: Firestore security rules tests, run against the local emulator. See TESTING.md.

scripts.test: JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.json --only firestore --project demo-pitchmark-rules "node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec tests/*.test.mjs"
